meta.title: Shahmath — Math Olympiad Training Center
meta.description: In Baku and online: professional preparation for the IMO, JBMO, RFO, BOM, IZhO and EGMO math olympiads. The first 2 lessons are trial lessons.

home.title: The road to the olympiad starts here
home.subtitle: Structured preparation for the IMO, JBMO, RFO, BOM, IZhO and EGMO: experienced teachers, a monthly mock exam and level-based groups.

features.title: 2 trial lessons
features.text: Use the first two lessons to get to know the center, the teacher and the pace.

features.title: Monthly mock exam
features.text: Every month there is an olympiad-style exam (sınaq) to measure progress.

features.title: Level-based groups
features.text: Based on results, students are split into subgroups so everyone moves at the right pace.

home.olympiadsSubtitle: Past problems, solutions and topic-based materials for every olympiad.
home.teachersSubtitle: A team of teachers with olympiad experience.
home.pricingSubtitle: Simple and transparent: one or two lessons per week.
home.ctaTitle: The first two lessons are trial lessons
home.ctaText: Fill in the form — we'll contact you on WhatsApp and pick the right group together.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Shahmath is an education center specializing in preparation for international mathematics olympiads.

pricing.trialText: After signing up, the first two lessons are trial lessons: the student meets the group and the teacher assesses their level.
pricing.howTitle: How the mock exam and subgroups work

steps.text: The student's level is assessed during the first two lessons.

steps.text: Every month there is a mock exam in olympiad format.

steps.title: Subgroups
steps.text: Based on results, students are split into level-based subgroups.

steps.title: Next month
steps.text: The cycle repeats monthly — a student who improves moves to a stronger group.
